title: The Amoraim of Nehardea
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Sanhedrin 17b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.17b.5), the designation “the Amoraim of Nehardea” refers to Rav Chama. Sefer HaKeritot, in the part Leshon Limmudim, gate 3, end of chapter 6, reads Rabbi Chanina; Hyman calls this a scribal error.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The heading supplies the designation “the Amoraim of Nehardea.” The preference for Rav Chama over Rabbi Chanina is Hyman’s textual judgment.

The linked Bavli and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=566&lang=en) both identify this expression with Rav Chama. Hyman rejects the form Rabbi Chanina, which he cites from Sefer HaKeritot.
